Soft landing tick as the crown lands on Mas's head (unpitched). No crowd 'ohh'.

keyboard_roll, straight 32nds accelerating, end-anchored on f240 (runs f225-239). The keyboard is the roll ([SCORE] cut the brush roll + revswell at f228). No tape_spinup.
